facts.text: Audrey takes her dogs for walks multiple times a day.

evidence.quote: Very often, multiple times a day even, it's a great exercise for them and great bonding time for us.

facts.text: Audrey's dogs include two Jack Russell mixes and two Chihuahua mixes.

evidence.quote: They're all mutts. Two of them are Jack Russell mixes and the other two are Chihuahua mixes.

facts.text: Audrey believes that some dog breeds bond better than others.

evidence.quote: And yea, I believe so! Some dog breeds do bond better than others.
